title: प्रमिथस
description: Devkota's महाकाव्य (epic) प्रमिथस retells the Greek myth of Prometheus — the fire-bringing Titan punished for aiding mankind — across eleven सर्ग (cantos), with a परिशिष्ट reproducing the earlier प्रगति-published version of the first canto. The manuscript is incomplete: चतुर्थ सर्ग survives only from श्लोक १४, and षष्ठ सर्ग jumps from श्लोक १० to ३३ (lost leaves) — the श्लोक numbering preserves these gaps as printed. The प्रज्ञा-प्रतिष्ठान editorial भूमिका and लैनसिंह बाङ्देल's foreword (both modern) are excluded; only Devkota's epic is archived. First published by साझा प्रकाशन (2028 BS); digitized from the print edition by OLE Nepal / pustakalaya.org.

rights.basis: Author died 1959; Nepal's Copyright Act 2059 grants life + 50 years, expiring 2009. Verify before publishing.
